useCase: scientific-educational Dino Atlas M0 scene-role comparison

policy.scope: environment-only ambient motion over a fixed approved still

copyrightSafety.note: Each sample derives only from its named project-owned generated still and a locally composited abstract environmental layer. No external footage or artwork is used.

workflow.motionRule: Keep every dinosaur, egg, camera, and anatomy pixel fixed. Animate only an isolated water reflection, wind-borne pollen layer, or upper dust-front layer.

psittacosaurus-mongoliensis-water-shimme.motionLayer: localized moving water reflections behind the right side of the animal
psittacosaurus-mongoliensis-water-shimme.prompt: M0 solo-scene test: preserve the complete animal and the sparse genus-level proximal-to-middle tail-bristle row exactly; composite only two subtle moving water-reflection bands in the clear lower-right background; no body, limb, head, tail, bristle, camera, or habitat deformation.
psittacosaurus-mongoliensis-water-shimme.evidenceBoundary: The bristle row is a genus-level soft-tissue reference derived from Psittacosaurus sp. evidence and is not asserted as mandatory for P. mongoliensis. The motion adds no anatomical evidence.

motionQa.note: Water highlights stay below and behind the tail and hind foot; the full animal and every tail bristle remain outside the effect layer.

anatomy.note: The S7 genus-level bristle-reference verdict is inherited; motion supplies no species-level anatomy evidence.

motion.note: Fixed-animal and water-layer locality checks passed; significant change is 99.57% inside the water-reflection zone.

responsive.note: Click-to-play, muted inline playback, poster fallback, role labels, card containment, and no horizontal overflow passed at 1440x900, 390x844, and 844x390 on 2026-08-03.

publication.note: M0 scene-role sample passed file, motion-locality, responsive, accessibility, provenance, and evidence-boundary gates on 2026-08-03.

maiasaura-peeblesorum-nesting-ground-pol.motionLayer: wind-borne seeds and pollen crossing the empty ground between the adult and nest
maiasaura-peeblesorum-nesting-ground-pol.prompt: M0 ecology-scene test: preserve the separated adult, nest, and nine visible eggs exactly; composite only small wind-borne seeds and a faint pollen band across the empty middle ground; no animal, egg, nest, plant, camera, or terrain deformation and no implied guarding, feeding, or contact.
maiasaura-peeblesorum-nesting-ground-pol.evidenceBoundary: Nesting sites and perinatal material are supported, but this exact adult attendance, maternity, guarding, egg appearance, egg count, and moment are reconstructed. The scene does not depict direct care.

motionQa.note: Pollen remains in the empty middle-ground band; the adult, nest rim, and eggs stay outside the effect layer.

anatomy.note: The approved S3 anatomy-review and nesting-hypothesis boundary are inherited; motion adds no care-behavior evidence.

motion.note: Fixed-adult, fixed-egg, and middle-ground locality checks passed; significant change is 99.53% inside the pollen zone.

responsive.note: Click-to-play, muted inline playback, poster fallback, role labels, card containment, and no horizontal overflow passed at 1440x900, 390x844, and 844x390 on 2026-08-03.

publication.note: M0 scene-role sample passed file, motion-locality, responsive, accessibility, provenance, and evidence-boundary gates on 2026-08-03.

velociraptor-protoceratops-dustfront-int.motionLayer: slow upper-frame dust-front drift above the separated animals
velociraptor-protoceratops-dustfront-int.prompt: M0 interspecies-scene test: preserve the complete separated Velociraptor and Protoceratops exactly and composite only a slow dust-front layer in the clear upper background; no head, feather, frill, limb, tail, camera, or ground deformation; no contact, chase, strike, wound, or fighting motion.
velociraptor-protoceratops-dustfront-int.evidenceBoundary: The exact taxa are directly associated in the Fighting Dinosaurs specimen, but this distant non-contact pose, dust front, colors, and moment are reconstructed and do not reproduce the fossil pose or assert an outcome.

motionQa.note: The moving dust remains above the two complete silhouettes; neither animal enters the effect layer.

anatomy.note: The approved S5 interaction-scene anatomy review is inherited; the motion adds no identity evidence.

motion.note: Fixed-two-animal and upper-dust locality checks passed; significant change is 99.60% inside the dust-front zone.

responsive.note: Click-to-play, muted inline playback, poster fallback, role labels, card containment, and no horizontal overflow passed at 1440x900, 390x844, and 844x390 on 2026-08-03.

publication.note: M0 scene-role sample passed file, motion-locality, responsive, accessibility, provenance, and evidence-boundary gates on 2026-08-03.
